title: Remote Work Policy
description: Employees may work remotely up to 4 days per week with manager approval. Remote days must be logged in the HR system by end of day. Equipment is provided by IT upon request.
keywords: remote work, work from home, WFH, telecommute, manager approval, flexible schedule

title: Annual Leave Entitlement
description: Permanent employees accrue 25 paid leave days per year plus 10 public holidays. Unused leave may carry over up to 5 days into the next calendar year. Leave must be requested at least 7 days in advance unless approved as emergency leave.
keywords: annual leave, vacation, PTO, holidays, leave carryover, time off

title: Expense Reimbursement Policy
description: Business expenses up to 500 USD can be claimed without pre-approval. Larger amounts require prior approval from the department head. Receipts must be attached within 30 days. Reimbursement is processed within 10 business days.
keywords: expense, reimbursement, claims, receipts, approval, travel expenses

title: Corporate Credit Card Usage
description: Corporate cards are issued to staff on request. Cards may only be used for approved business expenses. Personal purchases are prohibited and result in disciplinary action. Monthly statements must be reconciled by the cardholder.
keywords: credit card, corporate card, purchasing, reconciliation, spend

title: Password Policy
description: All accounts require a password of at least 12 characters including upper and lower case letters, digits, and a symbol. Passwords must be changed every 90 days and may not be reused within 8 cycles. Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for all company systems.
keywords: password, MFA, authentication, security, credentials, login

title: Data Retention Policy
description: Customer data is retained for 24 months after the end of the business relationship, then securely deleted. Internal emails are retained for 7 years for legal compliance. Backup copies are kept for 30 days beyond the retention period.
keywords: data retention, deletion, backups, compliance, archiving, customer data

title: Incident Response Procedure
description: Security incidents must be reported to the security team within 1 hour of detection. The on-call responder classifies the incident as low, medium, high, or critical. Critical incidents trigger the crisis bridge and a mandatory post-incident review within 5 business days.
keywords: incident response, security incident, breach, reporting, on-call, escalation

title: Access Control Policy
description: Access to systems is granted on a least-privilege basis. Employees receive access based on role and must re-verify access every 90 days. Offboarding requires access revocation within 24 hours of the final day.
keywords: access control, least privilege, permissions, RBAC, offboarding, revocation

title: New Hire Onboarding
description: New hires receive a laptop, accounts, and badge on their first day. The onboarding checklist is completed over the first 2 weeks, including security training, HR paperwork, and a 30-60-90 day plan agreed with their manager.
keywords: onboarding, new hire, first day, checklist, training, laptop

title: Offboarding Procedure
description: When an employee departs, IT revokes access within 24 hours, the badge is collected, and the final paycheck plus unused leave payout is issued within 30 days. Exit interviews are offered to all departing staff.
keywords: offboarding, exit interview, termination, final paycheck, access revocation, departure

title: Product Return Policy
description: Products may be returned within 30 days of purchase in original condition for a full refund. Return shipping is free for defective items only. Customized products are non-refundable.
keywords: returns, refund, product return, defective, warranty, customer service

title: Product Warranty Terms
description: Standard products carry a 12-month limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. Batteries and consumables are covered for 6 months. Warranty does not cover accidental damage or unauthorized repairs. Claims must include proof of purchase.
keywords: warranty, repair, defect, coverage, replacement, proof of purchase

title: Shipping Timeframes
description: Domestic orders ship within 2 business days and arrive in 3-5 business days. Express shipping (1-2 days) is available for an additional fee. International orders take 10-15 business days and may incur customs duties.
keywords: shipping, delivery, express, international, customs, lead time

title: API Rate Limits
description: The public API allows 1000 requests per minute per API key for standard tier and 5000 per minute for enterprise tier. Bursts beyond the limit return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header. Limits can be raised on request for approved use cases.
keywords: API, rate limit, 429, throttling, enterprise, requests

title: API Authentication Guide
description: All API requests must include a Bearer token obtained from the developer portal. Tokens expire after 60 minutes and must be refreshed using the client ID and secret. Never share tokens in URLs or client-side code.
keywords: API, authentication, bearer token, OAuth, credentials, developer

title: Health Insurance Coverage
description: The company offers medical, dental, and vision insurance effective on the first day of the month following your start date. The employer covers 80% of the premium for employees and 50% for dependents.
keywords: health insurance, medical, dental, vision, benefits, premium

title: Learning & Development Budget
description: Each employee receives an annual learning budget of 1500 USD for courses, certifications, and conferences. Reimbursement follows the standard expense policy. Certifications that are business-critical are 100% covered.
keywords: learning budget, training, certification, conference, education, development

title: Vendor Payment Terms
description: Standard vendors are paid on net-30 terms. Early payment discounts of 2% apply for invoices paid within 10 days. Payments require a matching purchase order and approved invoice before processing.
keywords: vendor payment, net-30, invoice, purchase order, AP, accounts payable

title: Ethics & Conflict of Interest
description: Employees must disclose any personal or financial interest that could conflict with company interests within 10 business days. Gifts valued above 100 USD from vendors must be declined or reported. Violations are investigated by the compliance office.
keywords: ethics, conflict of interest, gifts, compliance, disclosure, bribery

title: Acceptable Use of Company Devices
description: Company devices may be used for personal purposes within reasonable limits. Downloading unlicensed software, storing personal customer data, or circumventing security controls is prohibited. Devices must be encrypted and returned on departure.
keywords: acceptable use, devices, laptop, personal use, encryption, software

title: Maternity & Parental Leave
description: Employees receive 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for birth, adoption, or surrogacy. Parents may take leave as a single continuous block or in two parts within the child's first year. Statutory entitlements apply where they exceed company policy.
keywords: parental leave, maternity, paternity, adoption, family leave, baby

title: Privacy & Data Protection
description: Personal data is processed in line with GDPR and CCPA. Employees handling personal data must complete annual privacy training. Data subject requests must be escalated to the DPO within 24 hours. Never share personal data outside approved systems.
keywords: privacy, GDPR, CCPA, personal data, data subject, DPO

title: Diversity & Inclusion Commitment
description: The company commits to inclusive hiring practices, pay equity reviews twice a year, and a zero-tolerance policy for discrimination and harassment. Any incident can be reported anonymously through the ethics hotline.
keywords: diversity, inclusion, harassment, discrimination, pay equity, ethics hotline

title: Software Purchase Approval
description: Software purchases above 200 USD per seat require IT approval to check security, licensing, and overlap with existing tools. Free tools that store customer data also require review. Approved tools are added to the internal software catalog.
keywords: software purchase, SaaS, procurement, license, approval, IT review
